parts.text: 代码合并回 develop/v3.0.0，提交推送
明白，按本机既定流程：子模块先合并进 `develop/v3.0.0` 并推送，再父仓库合并（更新 gitlink 到子模块合并提交）并推送，最后清理 worktree。先 fetch 两个仓库并确认当前基线（注意子模块 worktree 本地 `git` 解析有怪象，统一用显式 `--git-dir --work-tree`）。

tool_input.command:
$wt = "D:\repository\苏州市房地产监测V3-wt-bug-6373"
$wtSub = "$wt\zhi2-web-admin"
$wtGitDir = "D:\repository\苏州市房地产监测V3\.git\modules\zhi2-web-admin\worktrees\zhi2-web-admin"
Write-Host "=== SUBMODULE fetch ==="
git --git-dir="$wtGitDir" fetch origin 2>&1 | Out-String -Width 200
Write-Host "=== SUBMODULE state ==="
Write-Host ("HEAD branch : " + (git --git-dir="$wtGitDir" --work-tree="$wtSub" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD))
Write-Host ("fix branch  : " + (git --git-dir="$wtGitDir" rev-parse fix/bug-6373-preview-close))
Write-Host ("origin/dev  : " + (git --git-dir="$wtGitDir" rev-parse origin/develop/v3.0.0))
Write-Host "=== PARENT fetch ==="
git -C $wt fetch origin 2>&1 | Out-String -Width 200
Write-Host "=== PARENT state ==="
Write-Host ("HEAD branch : " + (git -C $wt rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD))
Write-Host ("fix branch  : " + (git -C $wt rev-parse fix/bug-6373-preview-close))
Write-Host ("origin/dev  : " + (git -C $wt rev-parse origin/develop/v3.0.0))
tool_input.description: Fetch both repos and inspect merge baselines
